answer: Start from employment verification proof. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The vine test is the live device, the oasis test is the locked stake, and the grove test is the graded history no template can fake. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
